last_completed_unit.action: Inspected exactly the official v0.1.12 Windows system-proxy helper boundary reached from Builder::from_system.
last_completed_unit.result: The helper opens HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings and returns without mutation if the key cannot be opened or ProxyEnable resolves to 0. When enabled, it populates builder.http from ProxyServer only if builder.http is empty, so a nonempty environment-derived HTTP proxy is not overwritten. It does not populate builder.https. It populates builder.no from ProxyOverride only if builder.no is empty, transforming semicolon separators to commas after trimming and removing '*.' substrings; a nonempty environment-derived NO_PROXY value is not overwritten. Missing/unreadable ProxyServer or ProxyOverride leaves the corresponding field unchanged.
